fills.researcher_notes: Power Express (950 MMcf/d, north from Compressor Station 165/Chatham in Pittsylvania Co VA to the VA/MD state line, target in-service Q3 2030) is in early open-season-stage development -- Williams' own binding open season ran June 2-July 2, 2025 (1line.williams.com notice) describing the project only as 'pipeline looping and additional compression along its existing Zone 5 mainline', with no facility table. Cardinal News' May 2025 reporting (https://cardinalnews.org/2025/05/13/another-transco-pipeline-project-planned-for-virginia/, verified 200/live) directly quotes the company: it 'could not provide a specific timeline or map of the Power Express project' and confirms 'no applications have been submitted to the Virginia State Corporation Commission or Federal Energy Regulatory Commission' as of that reporting -- i.e. no FERC docket exists yet from which an EA facility table (this country's usual diameter source) could be drawn. Searched: FERC eLibrary (no CP docket found), Federal Register, Williams/Transco newsroom and investor supplements, 1line.williams.com open-season postings, NGI/trade press. Diameter is not yet public because the project has not reached the design/filing stage that discloses it -- UNRESOLVED, not a compression-only blank-is-correct case (looping is explicitly planned), and not cited since nothing states a number.
